title: Section 2 — Players
description: Player data. Deduplication key: id (Steam ID) and name.

id.description: Player Steam ID (primary key, int64). The save file holds it as a bare decimal literal; the tool carries it as that exact text, a double being unable to represent it.

inventoryId.description: → Section 4 Inventory.id — the player's personal inventory

equipmentId.description: → Section 4 Inventory.id — the equipment worn by the player

playerPosition.description: 3D position of the player, formatted as 'x,y,z'

playerRotation.description: Quaternion rotation of the player, formatted as 'x,y,z,w'

playerGaugeOxygen.description: Oxygen gauge level (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

playerGaugeThirst.description: Hydration gauge level (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

playerGaugeHealth.description: Health gauge level (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

playerGaugeToxic.description: Player toxicity level (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0; lower is better)

host.description: true when this player hosts the session. Only one player can be the host.

planetId.description: Planet the player is currently on (must match the host's planet)

cameraView.description: Player camera view (added by a game update)

totalCraftedObjects.description: Total number of objects crafted by the player (added by a game update)

totalTerraTokenEarned.description: Total number of terra tokens earned by the player (added by a game update)
